_comment: "When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card WITHOUT BASE {d}. If you do, THEY discard it and YOU draw a card." Every part aimed somewhere else. 'Without base {d}' was ATTACK_HAS_KEYWORD keyword:'BASE_DEFENSE' -- there is no such keyword, so the test was false for every card in the game -- and it gated the whole ability rather than filtering which card. The SELECT_FROM_REF around it carried `conditions` and `effects` that it does not read, so its whole body was unreachable. The DISCARD inside named target:'SELECTED_CARD', a key DISCARD does not read, and defaulted to player SELF: had it been reachable, the ATTACKER would have discarded their own card. NO_BASE_DEFENSE is a new condition because a card with no printed {d} has base_defense None, which BASE_DEFENSE_LTE treats as missing and falls back to current defence. The LOOK_AT was briefly dropped in this rewrite on the reasoning that a filtered discard implies looking. That was wrong twice: 'look at their hand' is a real game action whose INFORMATION consequences a recorder and an agent both need to see, and an earlier fix in this same effort had already corrected this card's LOOK_AT from the opponent's DECK to their HAND. Removing it silently undid that.
